'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Lush LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Lush]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TRM
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
